required_changes.finding: A=1/1/1 is owner acquire success, not Abort cleanup. B=0 says Abort not called.

Existing R14 completion, R26 finish and pair release are sequential under distinct scopes, not an atomic all-or-nothing cross-layer transaction. Preserve ordering and current reservation; do not promise rollback across all three.
Derive actual complete window_module.c and test it linked with actual R26/entry/production pair. A values-only outcome/predicate or reimplemented recovery fixture cannot establish real integration.

owner_release_failure.behavior: Non-success release changes public rc to -EPROTO; raw Q remains in report and release_rc is logged. At that point R14 reservation is already free and R26 token already usable. This does not prove reference balance.
owner_release_failure.scope: Do not add an unrequested cross-layer transaction or wrapper-only poison that can target a subsequent concurrent call.
